title: Piano ending: continued zoom or wider view

clips.label: Piano into swans
clips.note: Spiral keys → feathered wings → flying swans
clips.details:
Eight seconds. A twisting keyboard becomes a sky of winged boats and swans with red sails. The original ending keeps zooming, enlarging the foreground wing and pushing the pearl moon out of view.

Krea Turbo generates the opening and every new painting. Each repaint starts from the warped previous painting, using three Euler intervals and CFG1. Time-based Lanczos transforms control spatial motion. RIFE 4.25 fills the gaps and never feeds back into generation. These editions preserve every painting and run 1.5 times faster than the original timeline: 24 fps, three paintings per displayed second, seven intermediate frames per pair.

clips.label: Piano into swans — wider view
clips.note: Same opening, then less late enlargement
clips.details:
Eight seconds. Identical to the original piano trial through four displayed seconds. A bounded scale correction and small upward shift then ease continued enlargement. Prompts, noise, seeds and twists stay unchanged. More small swans remain visible, but the result is busier; the assistant favors the original simpler ending.
